VELVETMOVE.menu.title: Velvet Move — Footsteps & Hop
VELVETMOVE.menu.surfacesHint: Click a surface to make the current scene use it. Open the sliders to add sound files.
VELVETMOVE.menu.surfacesHintPlayer: The GM chooses the floor for each scene. You can still set your own volume above.
VELVETMOVE.menu.isoHint: This scene is being projected by Isometric Perspective — the hop is aligned to its projection.
VELVETMOVE.menu.label: Name
VELVETMOVE.menu.noSounds: No sounds yet — add a file or a whole folder.
VELVETMOVE.menu.assignHint: Pin this surface onto the selected tokens, whatever scene they are on.
VELVETMOVE.menu.deleteConfirm: Delete the surface "{name}" and its sound list?
VELVETMOVE.notify.gmOnly: Only the GM can change the scene's floor.
VELVETMOVE.notify.noSounds: That surface has no sounds yet.
VELVETMOVE.notify.emptyFolder: No audio files were found in that folder.
VELVETMOVE.notify.noSelection: Select one or more tokens first.
VELVETMOVE.notify.lastSurface: At least one surface has to remain.
VELVETMOVE.settings.hopEnabled.name: Hop on movement
VELVETMOVE.settings.hopEnabled.hint: Tokens lift off the floor and land again with each step they take.
VELVETMOVE.settings.hopHeight.name: Hop height
VELVETMOVE.settings.hopHeight.hint: How high a token rises, as a fraction of one grid cell.
VELVETMOVE.settings.stepLength.name: Stride length
VELVETMOVE.settings.stepLength.hint: Grid cells covered per step. Below 1 gives short, quick steps; above 1 gives long, loping ones.
VELVETMOVE.settings.ignoreElevated.name: Ignore elevated tokens
VELVETMOVE.settings.ignoreElevated.hint: Tokens above ground level (flying, on a ledge) neither hop nor make footsteps.
VELVETMOVE.settings.soundEnabled.name: Footstep sounds
VELVETMOVE.settings.soundEnabled.hint: Play a sound each time a token's step lands.
VELVETMOVE.settings.masterVolume.name: Footstep volume
VELVETMOVE.settings.masterVolume.hint: Your own volume for footsteps. Each surface has its own trim on top of this.
VELVETMOVE.settings.audience.name: Whose steps you hear
VELVETMOVE.settings.audience.hint: Which tokens' footsteps reach your speakers.
VELVETMOVE.settings.audience.controlled: Only the token you are controlling
VELVETMOVE.settings.pitchVariation.name: Pitch variation
VELVETMOVE.settings.pitchVariation.hint: Randomly detunes each footstep so a short list of samples still sounds like walking.
